title: Tír na nÓg
summary: Tír na nÓg is a magical castle floating over Ireland. The castle is visible and physical only under the light of a full moon. The castle is guarded by Firbolg and Dullahan Titans.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Tír na nÓg finds itself in Celtic legends as an otherworldly island existing beyond the western edges of the map that was home to the spirits. Known among Seekers as the phantom castle of Ireland, the fairies which inhabit the floating castle are the Titans known as Firbolg and Dullahan. [S2E48]

Eathon Lambert took his wife, Sandra, on a moonlit picnic to the valley in County Kerry, Ireland to watch as Tír na nÓg appear in the moonlight. [S2E48]

It was later found by Scarlet Byrne, who was attacked by a rogue Firbolg Titan. Gaining the help of Lok Lambert, who had been having recurring dreams of finding his father at such a place, she enlisted the help of the Huntik Foundation team to return. While exploring the castle, an area of the floor dematerialized, and Lok and Cherit fell into a weak point between dimensions. In this Inter-dimensional World, he was able to speak to his father through a mirror into the Spirit World, Huntik. After returning through the power of Umbra, Lok invoked Pendragon to defeat the Dullahan and Firbolg Titans. Their Amulets secured, Den Fears bonded with one of the Dullahan Titans while Scarlet bonded with a Firbolg. [Back Home]
